body.label: Target
body.html: Up to three enemies within ranged Weapon Range and a sphere of radius 1.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each takes 1 weapon Damage and is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Each hit target's next ranged Action suffers -1 on its Success Die until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Lock - Suppression
rider.html: You may end Lock on one hit target to prevent its movement Reactions until the start of your next turn.
